note: P4346 (Pro 29:13) — the poor and the oppressor meet together; the LORD gives light to the eyes of both.

dims.v: shared humanity — the poor who meet the oppressor before one God

the poor man who meets the oppressor on common ground, both alike receiving the light of life from the LORD — a levelling truth that neither poverty nor oppression escapes the one God who gives them both their sight and breath
welded to the oppressor with whom he shares one God's light

rush (be poor) — 'the POOR man and the oppressor meet together; the LORD gives light to the eyes of both'; poor and oppressor share one Maker who gives both life (cf 22:2). The common gift of life levels them before God — and reminds the oppressor he is no less accountable.
shared accountability — the oppressor who owes his life to the same God as the poor

the oppressor who meets the poor on common ground, receiving the light of life from the same LORD — the one who grinds the poor yet depends on the God who also gives the poor their sight, and to whom he too must answer
welded to the poor with whom he shares one God's light

tok (oppression/oppressor) — 'the poor man and the OPPRESSOR meet together'; the oppressor shares the poor man's Maker and owes him his very sight. Emergent: the oppressor levelled with his victim before the God who gives both life — and judges both.
